data.name: Levente
data.long_meaning: A Hebrew name derived from the word 'Lev', meaning 'heart' or 'attention'. The name Levente can be interpreted as 'God's helper' or 'devoted to God'. This name is rooted in the Old Testament and holds significant meaning in Christian tradition.
